notes.note: Read the Play readback paragraph against scripts/query-google-play-release.mjs and scripts/verify-release-cohort.mjs at this revision. A read and its edit cleanup that both fail with a retryable class are retried (settleAttempt); any other cleanup failure after a failed read is final; the 65 s worst case (READBACK_WORST_CASE_MS) and the 90 s verifier limit (PLAY_ADAPTER_LIMIT_MS) are unchanged; a run that trips the verifier limit reports that the adapter did not finish and carries its stderr lines. The edit-invalidation behaviour is now attributed to Google's edits documentation and marked not verified here, with the consequence stated. Checked by reading, with the new query and verifier tests executed.

The verifier change adds an exported limit constant and a helper that runs the Play adapter and words its timeout failure; the page's Android and provider-state claims are unchanged and still accurate.
